name: New Mags from MWs
teaser: Magazines can never be too big
description_html:
Collection of magazines from COD WMs.

Some changes has to be made to correctly fit the magazine mounting mechanism and bolt-catch system.

Includes:

7.62x51mm AR-10 polymer 30-Round magazine

7.62x51 XRK 50-Round SCAR-H drum magazine

C-MAG 5.56x45 STANAG 100-Round drum magazine

6.8x51 Cronen 50-round drum magazine (AR-10 compitable, also takes .308)

5.56x45 Kimura STANAG 60-round drum magazine

7.62x51 100-Round SCAR-H drum magazine

5.56x45 AR-15 STANAG 40-round magazine

5.56x45 AR-15 STANAG 20-round magazine

AK 7.62x39 100-round drum magazine

MP7 4.6x30mm XRK 50-round drum magazine

MP9 9x19 FJX 50-round drum magazine

PP-19-01 9x19 45-round magazine

Glock .45 ACP Forge Tac 50-round drum magazine

Installion:

Just like other mods. Unzip and drop Mass_NCODMag folder into “[Your EFT Directory]/user/mods”.

You should be able to find them in Mechanic’s shop and on the flea market.

Models and textures are properties of Actvision;
